proposal.reason: Main change is SDK-version-gated BF16 intrinsic/conversion logic in core device collective kernels and vector cast helpers, which directly changes built-in device kernel implementations. Add symmetric because symmetric-memory CE/reduce kernels receive their own BF16 conversion gating and are a distinct execution path requiring specialized review; Makefile/header macro export, enqueue call-site gate, and GIN include-path update are supporting compatibility wiring for this same change.
